digest.component_or_area: test linting / code-review gate (DET blocking criterion)
propositions: Upper-bound wall-clock assertions in test code cause CI flake under runner contention and must be blocked by a detector serving as a DET code-review criterion.
Detector must recognize two escape patterns: reasoned '# timing: hang-guard' line markers and skipif(CI) perf-lane guards; bare @pytest.mark.benchmark without skipif does not escape.
Two test sites migrated from upper-bound assertions to counting-proxy spies: test_config_perf.py:201 spies _ordered_layers (cache miss-path), test_enrich_drain.py:261 counts pending_enrichment calls.
Remaining 9 in-scope test sites carry reasoned hang-guard markers and detector runs clean on the tree.
Detector is wired into CI pipeline as 'wall-clock-assert gate' step with unit test coverage for fire cases, both escapes, lower-bound exclusion, and self-exclusion via EXCLUDED_FILES.
